name: dsh-usage-footer
description: DSH web plugin: a floating usage/cost button with a hover panel (account balance, peak/off-peak bracket, cost estimate, session tokens, today's spend) and a General-settings on/off toggle, backed by the loopback-only GET /usage-status host route

scripts.check: node --check lib/client.js && node --check lib/pricing.js && node --check lib/ledger.js && node --check lib/platform.js && node --input-type=module -e "import('./lib/index.js').then(() => console.log('host module ok'))"
scripts.test: node test/baseline.test.mjs && node test/pricing.test.mjs && node test/ledger.test.mjs && node test/platform.test.mjs && node test/sync.test.mjs
